answer_1.quote: Specifically, given an image and a question querying spatial quantities in the image, the model needs to directly output the estimated quantities in text format
answer_1.outputs: text responses containing numerical estimates of spatial properties with specific formatting requirements (\scalar{value} \distance_unit{unit})

answer_2.quote: We measure the performance in success rate by thresholding the maximum ratio between an estimation and a ground truth value. Given a distance estimation d and a ground truth value d*, the maximum ratios between the estimation and ground truth can be expressed as... Following existing works, we set the thresholds to 1.25 and 2 and denote the evaluation metrics as δ ≤1.25 and δ ≤2, respectively.

answer_3.quote: To quantify the above observation, we first count the number of instances where the GPT-4o output involves reasoning via a reference object to answer the question. To do this, we feed the sampled GPT-4o responses to a separate GPT-4o instance which we prompt to determine if a model response uses any reference object as guidance (see Appendix C for details).
